entities.summary: Daniel Nwosu Jr., professionally known by his stage name Dax, is a Canadian singer and rapper. He has recorded two albums, Pain Paints Paintings (2021) and From a Man's Perspective (2024). He has achieved certifications in Canada and the United States for his singles "Dear Alcohol" and "To Be a Man."
